title: Arbitrary coproduct closure of an ambient ind property
statement: Let C be a category with all colimits indexed by categories whose objects and arrows lie in universe w, and with finite coproducts. Let P be an object property closed under finite coproducts. Then P.ind, the object property of objects admitting a w-small filtered colimit presentation by objects in P, is closed under coproducts indexed by any type I in universe w. The coproducts and filtered colimits are taken in C, including the empty coproduct.

proof.text: Choose a small filtered presentation for each summand. The product of their indexing categories is filtered, and its projection to each factor is final. Reindex each presentation along this projection. Form the diagram of all finite partial coproducts of the resulting stages, indexed by the product category and the finite-subset poset of I. This indexing category is filtered, and every object of this diagram is in P by finite-coproduct closure.

Use the finite-partial-coproduct colimit construction and Fubini for colimits to identify the colimit of this single filtered diagram with the desired coproduct of the original colimits. Transport the presentation along that canonical colimit isomorphism. The empty product category and empty finite subset include I empty. These constructions are implemented by Mathlib Limits.Constructions.Filtered, Limits.Fubini, and ColimitPresentation; no project-level ind-heart closure lemma is used.
